comparison.objective: Safely retrieve low toast by unplugging a toaster, holding its extra-lift lever, and using wooden tongs; candidate configures a gripper stop.
comparison.physical_skill: Safe sequencing, sustained lever holding, tong grasping, and object extraction.
comparison.success_condition: Requires unplugging, avoiding the fork, transferring toast, returning the lever and tools, and clearing the scene.
comparison.reason: Sustained lever operation and safe extraction do not overlap meaningfully with setting and locking an adjustable stop.
